timeline.text: Welcome to Nervous Before a Doctor’s Appointment. I will guide you through each tapping point. At every point, you will hear a short phrase. Repeat it aloud, or quietly inside your head. Let us begin.

timeline.ins: Begin tapping on the side of your hand.
timeline.say: I feel nervous about this appointment.

timeline.ins: Now tap the top of your head.
timeline.say: My mind keeps imagining difficult news.

timeline.ins: Move to the beginning of your eyebrows.
timeline.say: I do not like feeling out of control.

timeline.ins: Now tap at the side of your eyes.
timeline.say: I am anticipating every uncomfortable part.

timeline.ins: Move under your eyes.
timeline.say: My body is already bracing for the visit.

timeline.ins: Now tap under your nose.
timeline.say: I want reassurance before I even arrive.

timeline.ins: Move to your chin.
timeline.say: Part of me wants to cancel or avoid it.

timeline.ins: Now tap your collarbones.
timeline.say: I can admit that this feels scary.

timeline.ins: Finish this round under your arm.
timeline.say: I am carrying the whole appointment at once.

timeline.text: Take one easy breath. Notice whether anything has shifted, even slightly. If nothing has changed yet, that is completely okay. Keep breathing, and we will continue.

timeline.ins: Return to the side of your hand.
timeline.say: I can meet this appointment one step at a time.

timeline.ins: Tap the top of your head.
timeline.say: An anxious thought is not a medical fact.

timeline.ins: Move to the beginning of your eyebrows.
timeline.say: I can ask questions and take my time.

timeline.ins: Tap at the side of your eyes.
timeline.say: I only need to handle the moment I am in.

timeline.ins: Move under your eyes.
timeline.say: My body can soften before I arrive.

timeline.ins: Tap under your nose.
timeline.say: I am allowed to ask for clarity and support.

timeline.ins: Move to your chin.
timeline.say: Going to the appointment is an act of care.

timeline.ins: Tap your collarbones.
timeline.say: I can breathe through uncertainty.

timeline.ins: Finish this round under your arm.
timeline.say: I can let the future wait for actual information.

timeline.text: Take another slow breath. Notice what feels different now. You do not need the feeling to disappear. See if there is simply a little less pressure, or a little more choice in how you meet this moment.

timeline.ins: Return to the side of your hand.
timeline.say: I am ready to care for myself today.

timeline.ins: Tap the top of your head.
timeline.say: I can listen without jumping ahead.

timeline.ins: Move to the beginning of your eyebrows.
timeline.say: I trust myself to ask what I need to know.

timeline.ins: Tap at the side of your eyes.
timeline.say: I can pause if I feel overwhelmed.

timeline.ins: Move under your eyes.
timeline.say: My body deserves patience and respect.

timeline.ins: Tap under your nose.
timeline.say: I can receive information one piece at a time.

timeline.ins: Move to your chin.
timeline.say: I do not have to be fearless to show up.

timeline.ins: Tap your collarbones.
timeline.say: I can bring steadiness into the room.

timeline.ins: Finish under your arm.
timeline.say: I am ready for the next step.

timeline.text: Let your hands rest, and take one full breath. Notice how you feel now, without needing to judge it. Thank you for taking this time for yourself. Carry this steadiness with you as you continue.
